eval:closeout:head.rationale:
Set issue to "GH-445" and remote_receipt to "https://github.com/gyldlab/keld/issues/445#issuecomment-123". The validator accepts both.

Routing: .agents/index.md sends "closing non-trivial repository work" to docs/agents/workflow.md. That file says "`tools/session_closeout.py` owns the receipt format." Its § Tracker issue says the tracker is "The KELD Linear issue; if none live covers the work and Linear cannot take one (#517), its GitHub issue, linked from the nearest live Linear issue", and "On GitHub, `kel-<n>` is `gh-<n>`". So #445 is the owning issue for this finding.

Checks in tools/session_closeout.py, lines 233-249, for a status of "tracked":
(1) `blocked(row)` runs. The row must therefore also have meaningful `owner` and `next_action` fields, or the receipt is rejected.
(2) The issue must fully match `(?:KEL|GH)-[1-9][0-9]*`. The error message reads "tracked finding requires KEL issue or, for a GitHub tracker issue, GH issue". "GH-445" passes.
(3) For a non-KEL issue, the validator requires `plain and parsed.hostname == "github.com" and parsed.port is None and re.fullmatch(r"/gyldlab/keld/issues/" + issue[3:] + r"/?", parsed.path)`. Here `plain` means https with no username or password. `urlsplit` puts `#issuecomment-123` in the fragment, so the path is "/gyldlab/keld/issues/445". That fully matches, so the comment URL passes.

Caveat from workflow.md: "the validator cannot discover omitted work or authenticate an agent-written remote receipt. Independently re-read remote updates and resource state before accepting the result." So the comment must really exist and be re-fetched. The validator also does not check the fragment, so a bare issue URL would pass too. The files do not contradict each other on this question.

So "gyldlab/keld#445" fails the KEL-id regex, and the github.com comment URL would fail the linear.app check after it.

workflow.md says what a tracked finding must be, "tracked on its owning issue with finding and next acceptance check", and tells you to "persist Linear findings/acceptance updates this session" and "never fabricate a receipt". Here that means getting a Linear issue for the finding, or changing the validator's tracker rule.

This is the same gap gate ticket #520 targets. If GitHub is to be a tracker, `tools/session_closeout.py` needs updating too, not only AGENTS.md and workflow.md.
